g.title: j3261452690
g.text: Mon miracle, I will not take much of your time today - I simply wished to take a moment to thank you once more for your being here.

g.title: j3241978011
g.text: My friend, I will not take much of your time today - I simply wished to take a moment to thank you once more for your being here.

g.title: j2885463974
g.text: I will sit in quiet prayer in thanks to whatever god guided you to us that you have had the patience... the kindness... to listen to me at such length.

g.title: j2046060991
g.text: I will sit in quiet prayer in thanks to whatever god guided you to us that you have had the patience... the kindness... to listen to me at such length.

g.title: j3277533796
g.text: That I could speak so much of my pain to you, and you endured it? And ask nothing of me in return... My thanks are paltry in comparison.

g.title: j4294739340
g.text: I know that what I have become, what I have always been, is not so easy for others to suffer.

g.title: j1704665780
g.text: That I could so heedlessly speak the truth of my soul to you and you withstood it with nothing but an open heart.

g.title: j722534986
g.text: That I could so heedlessly speak the truth of my soul to you and you withstood it with nothing but open arms.

g.title: j2389167653
g.text: And for all the patience you have granted me, I am most grateful.

g.title: j3411574953
g.text: Mon miracle, I will kneel at your altar, a most dedicated and devoted servant and soldier.

g.title: j3899939662
g.text: My friend, I shall fight beside you, come what may. How could I not seek to guard you, who has stolen the heart of my sister?

g.title: j3490612466
g.text: My friend, I shall fight beside you, come what may. How could I not seek to guard you, who has managed to temper the devil himself?

g.title: j1968484716
g.text: My friend, I shall fight beside you, come what may.

g.title: j2517547685
g.text: Wherever you may go. Whatever battles you may fight. Wherever your heart may wander -

g.title: j3279954213
g.text: Wherever you go, whatever battles you may fight - you shall have me there at your side.
